title: Booger Knights
html:
Quest Giver: Doctor Whom the Eleventh

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Equip the headbucket. Spar with any 20 partners in Level 6 of MutantMania. As you get the snot beat out of you, collect 30 boogers. Return all boogers AND the headbucket to Doctor Whom the Eleventh in that same level.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Doctor Whom the Eleventh

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Deliver Medical Report to Colonel Cabo

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Equip the headbucket. Spar with any 20 partners in Level 6 of MutantMania. As you get the snot beat out of you, collect 30 boogers. Return all boogers AND the headbucket to Doctor Whom the Eleventh in that same level.

Offer:

Sooooo, I see here the Commishy-boy needs a new medical exam for you.

First, I need you to check your heart rate. Get out of my office and spar with pretty much anyone on this level to get your ticker pumping. Mix it up with, oh, let's say 20 partners.

Also, I will need a fluids test. Snot works wonders and provides incredible research data, so I want you to get out there and get the snot beat out of you!

Here is a nice bucket. Put it on your head. Yes, you heard me, put it on your head--but I want my bucket *back* after the tests! Now, go get the snot beat out of you. Looking at the size of you, I figure 30 boogers should help me with my testing, and ummmmm...experimenting.

Turn-in:

MMMmmm let me get a sample of this.

*Dips his finger into the bucket*

Quite a copious amount. Nice consistency. Excellent color. Fair to average clarity.

Objectives:

  • Bucket ×1
  • ''Spar'' with 20 Partners
  • Boogers ×30

Level range: 88–100
